feature: Share a conversation's summaries, words or audio

scenarios.name: Offer only the parts a conversation has
scenarios.given: a conversation may have a Quick summary, a full summary, transcript or notes, and saved audio
scenarios.when: the user opens Share for it
scenarios.then: Quick summary, Full summary, Whole conversation and Audio are offered in that order, each only when it has something to send, and blank summaries are not offered

scenarios.name: A summary is shared without the transcript
scenarios.given: a conversation has a Quick summary, a full summary, notes and transcript
scenarios.when: the user shares Quick summary or Full summary
scenarios.then: the share sheet receives readable text with only the title, recording date and the chosen summary; Whole conversation still sends everything and Audio sends the saved files instead of text

scenarios.name: Every Share entry point opens the share sheet
scenarios.given: a saved conversation is open, or listed in History
scenarios.when: the user chooses More → Share → Whole conversation, or swipes a History row and chooses Whole conversation, or touches and holds the row
scenarios.then: the system share sheet opens with the chosen content and Copy pastes readable text, and the touch-and-hold menu offers Share
